# Stormatics

> > Professional PostgreSQL consulting, database optimization, and 24×7 support services for high-availability applications.

Stormatics specializes in PostgreSQL database administration, performance tuning, and scaling solutions. The company provides DBA services, consulting, and resources including case studies, webinars, and technical documentation for organizations running mission-critical PostgreSQL deployments.

## Key Topics

- PostgreSQL
- Database optimization
- High availability
- PostgreSQL consulting
- DBA services
- Database scaling
- pg_cirrus
- PostgreSQL 18
- 24×7 support
- Performance tuning
- Case studies
- Database migration
- Query optimization
- Replication
- Backup and recovery
